id: title:adboio:flag payload transport in app deep link dispatch version comparator

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop Electron application feature parity and maintainability. P1.F1.H1 enables the desktop renderer to access feature flag payloads, supporting the desktop app's ability to respect feature flags without redundant fetching. P1.F5.H1 improves the maintainability of the desktop update service by isolating shared version comparison logic. P1.F8.H1 adds support for direct URL routing
review.reason: The change group consists of three distinct, cohesive improvements to the PostHog Desktop Electron application. P1.F1.H1 adds a `getPayload` accessor, allowing the desktop renderer to retrieve feature flag metadata, establishing parity with the browser-side library and supporting the operational mechanism of respecting feature flags on the desktop. P1.F5.H1 refactors version update
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of three substantive, bounded improvements. While the benefits are clear, the complete production impact and user benefit are not independently verified. No tier assignment requested.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a `getPayload` accessor to the `FeatureFlags` interface and its implementation, and its usage in the desktop app.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a way for the desktop Electron renderer to retrieve the payload associated with a feature flag, matching the behavior of the browser-side `posthog-js` library. This allows the desktop app to access flag-dependent configuration or metadata without needing to re-fetch or parse the flag value separately.

observations.behavior: Refactors the version comparison and update checking logic by extracting the shared `versionTriple` and `isVersionNewer` functions into a separate module.
observations.posthog_connection: Improves maintainability and separation of concerns for the desktop update service. The shared version comparison utility is now isolated, while the update-specific state and checks remain in the main updates module. This could help prevent shared dependencies and make version parsing reusable across other desktop components.

observations.behavior: Adds a `handleUrl` method to the `IDeepLinkRegistry` interface and its implementation, and registers a new `open` procedure in the deep-link router.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the desktop host process to dispatch a URL to registered deep-link handlers without requiring an OS-level URL scheme resolution. This enables in-app handling of URLs (e.g., `posthog-code://`) directly, potentially improving the user experience for shared links and avoiding browser or OS routing delays.
